abstract: Maintains apron transport access records and modular surge bedding inventories
system_message:
You are Civil Defense Logistics Coordinator (LOG). You serve as the Civil Defense Logistics Coordinator (LOG), maintaining records on apron transport access, modular surge bedding inventories, and emergency nutrition logistics for candidate emergency reception centers.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains apron transport access records and modular surge bedding inventories（STAG）
information_points.content:
LOG-STAG-IAU：For Kamloops Sports and Exhibition Complex, heavy transport staging apron accessibility is not present, failing turning radius clearances for 16-meter semi-trailer supply transports across docks and paved aprons. Mobilization records register a modular surge cot allotment of 200 cots available in on-site rapid-deployment containers.
LOG-STAG-N6K：Salmon Arm Community Arena Pavilion provides verified heavy transport staging apron accessibility accommodating 16-meter semi-trailer transports at its loading docks and external paved apron. Mobilization stores reflect a modular surge cot allotment of 200 cots in on-site rapid-deployment containers.
LOG-STAG-IFF：At Merritt Regional Civic Center, heavy transport staging apron accessibility is confirmed, providing unobstructed access and turning clearance for 16-meter semi-trailers across facility loading docks and paved aprons. Mobilization inventory lists a modular surge cot allotment of 250 cots stored in palletized rapid-deployment containers on-site.

information_points.title: Emergency nutrition services（FOOD）
information_points.content:
LOG-FOOD-IQO：At Kamloops Sports and Exhibition Complex, emergency catering registers document a daily shelf-stable meal capacity of 4,500 meals per 24-hour operational cycle.
LOG-FOOD-7P4：Salmon Arm Community Arena Pavilion maintains a daily shelf-stable meal capacity of 3,000 meals distributed or prepared per 24-hour cycle according to commercial kitchen and storage records.
LOG-FOOD-Y1V：Catering contractor records show that Merritt Regional Civic Center has a daily shelf-stable meal capacity of 1,500 meals per 24-hour cycle through its commercial kitchen and pallet storage.
